title: Glowing Garden Match
theme: A magical garden of glowing flowers and plants that must be matched to restore the garden's light.
mechanics: Swap adjacent tiles to form matches of three or more identical flowers
Cleared tiles disappear and new tiles fall from above
Create chains by setting up cascading matches
Reach a target score to complete the level

controls.action: Select a tile and swap it with an adjace
controls.key: Click a tile, then click an adjacent til
